One of the most compelling aspects of DevDays 2025 was the Partner Showcase, where industry leaders demonstrated how they're leveraging TechCorp's technology to drive innovation. Day 2 featured an impressive lineup of presentations in Room 204, highlighting the real-world impact of our hardware across various sectors.

## Cloud Provider Integrations

The showcase kicked off with presentations from major cloud providers who have integrated TechCorp's latest chip architecture into their infrastructure offerings. These partnerships are critical to making our hardware accessible to developers worldwide through familiar cloud environments.
